hints.title: Odd Identifier and Non-Boring Description Filter
hints.text: Filter movie titles with odd-numbered identifiers and descriptions not equal to "boring", ordered by rating.

hints.title: Modulo Condition and Rating Sorting
hints.text: Apply id % 2 = 1 and description <> "boring" in the where clause, sorting the resulting rows by rating in descending order.

hints.title: Movie Query Blueprint
hints.text: select id, movie, description, rating from cinema where id % 2 = 1 and description <> "boring" order by rating desc.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT id, movie, description, rating
FROM cinema
WHERE id % 2 = 1 
  AND description <> 'boring'
ORDER BY rating DESC;
```

variables: N: number of records in cinema table
complexity.notes: Filtering evaluates in linear time; sorting by rating takes linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Case sensitive inequality can fail without exact string matching.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place filter executes directly without auxiliary memory structures.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of modulo operator id % 2 = 1 and string inequality operator <>.
